reviewNotes: Reviewed all 266 distinct exported speech keys from 80 cards against data/particle-drill.json vocabulary/furigana and particle context before Nova generation. Sentence/dialogue and cloze question prompts and complete explanations use speed 1.0. Standalone particles, short particle combinations, and combined answer choices use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ selected by exact key and occurrence, including quoted particle names; lexical は in 母(はは), 話す/話し(はなす/はなし), 走り(はしり), 払う(はらう), 支払い(しはらい), 判断(はんだん), 範囲(はんい), 入れる(はいれる), 初めて(はじめて), 八時(はちじ), 昼ご飯(ひるごはん), and 省く(はぶく) preserved. Checked the boundary distinction between 公園で走りました (で + はしりました) and topic では, カードで払います (で + はらいます), and 食べ物は要りません (は + いりません). All へ and を occurrences in this deck are directional/object particles, including quoted choices: -> え and お. Particle combinations retain distinct lookup keys: への -> えの, へは -> えわ, をは -> おわ, をの -> おの. Katakana converted to hiragana preserving long vowels and gemination. Added final stops to bare particle/choice fragments. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. Written pronunciation review only; no audible articulation or pitch-accent verification.
